title: Holy Water
summary: Throw up to 60 ft to deal 3d6 Radiant to nearby Fiends and Undead.

fields.Throw: Action. Consume one flask, throwing it up to 60 ft. Fiends and Undead in a 7 ft radius take 3d6 Radiant, half on a DC 13 Dexterity save.
fields.Surface: Creates a 7 ft radius Water surface. It puts out unprotected flames and can freeze or become electrified.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
